title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
description:
About PAICON PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide.
 The role We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office.
 You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders.
 What you'll do Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion
 Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps
 Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines
 Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure
 Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable
 Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations
 Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks
 What you bring Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines
 Strong SQL and relational database design skills
 R and Python skills on Linux systems
 Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems
 Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR

title: HRIS - Lead Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Lead Data Engineer - HR Data Migration (Workday) - People VF

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement en interne, nous recrutons un·e Lead Data Engineer, basé·e à Lille.

Nous souhaitons accélérer la transformation et la digitalisation de nos processus RH, en partie grâce à une forte maîtrise de nos données People et de leurs usages. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous déployons une plateforme RH mondiale (Workday) qui intégrera un CORE RH et plusieurs modules de talent management pour les 65 pays dans lesquels Decathlon est implanté.

Votre mission : Au croisement de la stratégie et de l'exécution technique, vous serez le/la garant·e technique de la migration de nos données depuis nos systèmes legacy vers Workday. En tant que Lead Data Engineer, vous concevrez l'architecture de transformation, piloterez la création des pipelines de données, et mettrez en place un monitoring rigoureux pour assurer une migration "zéro défaut". Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du Program Leader et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet locales et globales.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

1. Architecture et Stratégie de Transformation des données :

  • Définir l'architecture technique et la stratégie de migration des données de nos systèmes sources (legacies) vers le template cible Workday.

  • Identifier le périmètre technique de la migration et concevoir des modèles de données répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et de sécurité.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £55k-£70k
Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.
 Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre , form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.
How we work in 2026
Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. The bar has moved with it; planning and judgement matter more than typing speed.
 Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill - and if you'd rather work the "old" way, that's fair - but we're probably not the place for you.
 Our Data team builds and runs the data platform behind both products. That means sourcing property data, scraping the property portals with our in-house tool Road, and serving it all through Kraken , our UK property data API. Terabytes of data move through the platform every night, and since we launched a new version of Road there’s more to do than ever. Nobody owns a single pipeline, so you’ll flex across all of it. At this level, the platform is yours to steer: you won’t just build things well; you’ll decide how they should be built, and call it out when the way we’ve always done it is no longer the right way.
If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them.
 Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet.
 You will build the foundation that fixes this.

 Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production.
 Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team.

 Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today.

title: Data Engineer
description:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.
 Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen.
 Wat ga je doen?
 Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.
 Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.
 Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.
 Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.
 Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
 Technologie staat niet…

title: Data Engineer H/F - Paris
description:

 Nous intervenons chez nos clients sur des missions 100% data qui allient des dimensions techniques et stratégiques , où la donnée est le moteur de la performance opérationnelle . En tant que Data Engineer, vous êtes l'architecte qui rend la donnée exploitable. Selon votre profil, vous interviendrez sur la construction de plateformes data robustes (Data Lakehouse) ou sur l'industrialisation de flux complexes destinés à l'IA.
 Nos clients (Luxe, Retail, Télécom, Banque...) font face à une explosion des volumes et des sources de données. Votre rôle sera de garantir la fluidité, la qualité et la sécurité de ces flux.

 Migration d'un legacy on-premise vers une architecture Cloud Lakehouse (Snowflake/Databricks). #CloudMigration

 Audit et refonte de pipelines d’ingestion pour réduire les coûts de calcul et de stockage sur GCP ou AWS. #Performance
 Développement de composants Kafka, exposition via API et garantie de la performance des flux temps réel à l'échelle internationale. #Streaming

 Ayant un excellent relationnel pour faire le pont entre les besoins métiers et les contraintes IT,

 Dotés d’un esprit d’analyse rigoureux,
 Qui accordent une importance capitale à la qualité du code (CI/CD, tests unitaires) et à la documentation technique (Confluence/Jira),
